document.abstract: Two features that would add to the enjoyment and realism of sound in motion picture theaters are an increased volume range and a more widespread source of sound for music and effects reproduction. A method of accomplishing these aims is described which employs a control-track printed in the sprocket-hole area of the release print to operate a variable-gain amplifier and loud speaker control equipment.
